description: This file defines data structures and methods related to histograms, including histogram buckets, sample histograms, and their JSON serialization/deserialization, used within the Prometheus monitoring system.

classes.name: FloatString
classes.description: A float64 type that serializes/deserializes as a quoted string in JSON.

classes.name: HistogramBucket
classes.description: Represents a histogram bucket with boundaries, lower and upper bounds, and count.

classes.name: SampleHistogram
classes.description: Encapsulates histogram data including count, sum, and buckets.

classes.name: SampleHistogramPair
classes.description: Pairs a timestamp with a sample histogram, with JSON serialization.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of FloatString.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes FloatString to JSON as a quoted string.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON quoted string into FloatString.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two HistogramBucket instances.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of HistogramBucket.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two HistogramBuckets slices.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of SampleHistogram.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two SampleHistogram instances.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of SampleHistogramPair.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two SampleHistogramPair instances.
